assumptions.decomposition: Complete-source balanced fixed source x fixed seed SS. Raw ANOVA variance components assume random independent source and seed effects with homoscedastic residual; negative estimates retained and also clipped for descriptive fractions. Residual includes interaction and unexplained noise.
assumptions.sampling_scope: Only three prescribed seeds. Within-source variance is empirical across those seeds, not established variance under new actions, a policy, or fresh sources. Shared sources across cohorts; cohorts never pooled.
assumptions.hoeffding: DERIVED: bounded independent rounds; each option range width <=B; unique best separated by gap or every ordering pair separated by gap. D_ij range width <=2B. n >= 2 B^2 log(M/delta)/gap^2, M=K-1 or K(K-1)/2. Simultaneous error <=delta, conditional on assumptions. K*n reward evaluations.
assumptions.gaussian: DERIVED plug-in only: n >= z_(1-delta/M)^2 * Var(D)/gap^2. Independent equal-variance option approximation Var(D)=2v; measured pairs use empirical Var(D). No finite-sample guarantee, variance uncertainty, or future-option transfer guarantee. Zero observed variance does not imply zero true variance.
assumptions.reward_bounds: Binary width1. Internal normalized-correlation absolute bound sqrt320 yields conservative width2sqrt320 with fixed threshold; this does not rely on observed min/max or assert nonnegative decoded scores. External match count width=payload bits. Margins are not probabilities and are not interchangeable with C/J.
assumptions.paired_CRN: Same source/seed within cohort can provide empirical paired differences. CRN benefit is measured for retained arms only; same numeric seed does not establish identical random streams or positive covariance for new methods. Bounds allow dependence among options within a round, require independence across rounds.
assumptions.continuous_gradient: Not identifiable without actions and score/log-gradient vectors. Conditional toy: Gaussian mean policy a=theta+sigma*z, z~N(0,I_d); zero-mean reward noise epsilon independent of z with Var(epsilon)=v, baseline removes conditional mean. Then trace Cov(mean epsilon*z/sigma)=d*v/(n*sigma^2). This is only an additive noise term, not total policy-gradient variance, learning cost, or a usable policy return estimate.
assumptions.cost: SOURCE BRIEF seconds: regeneration .54/.99/1.24/1.98 + reader1.4 + quality.25; price .551 USD/device-hour. F5 732s shard latency /6 approximately122 device-equivalent seconds. F6 361-723 unmeasured planning seconds per mark. Conversion assumes those timing scopes add and hardware/price stay comparable; no new measurements.
